title: PluginListPlus
description: A more readable plugin list with customizable aesthetic themes and styles.
body:
A clean, styled replacement for /plugins, /pl, and /plist.
A more readable plugin list with aesthetic themes, multiple display styles, GUI tools, and privacy controls.

---

◆ 5 Display Styles   ◆   10 Themes   ◆   GUI / Chat Config   ◆   GUI / Book List   ◆   Private Mode

--- PluginListPlus replaces the default Minecraft plugin list with a cleaner, more polished, and more customizable version for server owners who want something better than the default /plugins output. It is built for servers that want plugin information to look intentional instead of messy, plain, or exposed in a way that does not fit the server. ## ▌ Display Styles --- ### ◆ Compact Fits the full plugin list into as few lines as possible. Best for quick checks, smaller screens, and servers that want a clean chat-based layout without wasting space. --- ### ◆ Grouped Splits enabled and disabled plugins into separate groups, making it easier to check plugin status at a glance. --- ### ◆ Boxed Shows one plugin per line inside a clean framed layout. This style is useful when readability matters more than compact spacing. --- ### ◆ Categorized Sorts plugins by Paper, Bukkit, and status-based categories for a more organized server overview. --- ### ◆ Detailed Shows versions, authors, badges, and extra plugin information. > This style is more experimental and is not recommended for every setup, but it is useful for deeper plugin inspection. ## ▌ Themes --- PluginListPlus includes multiple built-in themes so the plugin list can better match your server style. | Theme | Style | |---|---| | Gold | Clean, warm, premium | | Crimson | Dark red, bold, sharp | | Emerald | Green, clean, stable | | Sunset | Orange, warm, energetic | | Ocean | Blue, fresh, readable | | Galaxy | Purple, modern, stylized | | Cherry | Pink/red, bright, polished | | Arctic | Light blue, cold, minimal | | Neon | Bright green, high contrast | | Rainbow | Colorful, playful, standout | ## ▌ Admin Tools --- ### ◆ Interactive Config Panel Change the active style, theme, sorting mode, badges, versions, legend, and gradients directly in-game. ### ◆ Inventory GUI Configure the plugin visually without needing to manually type every command. ### ◆ Book View Open the plugin list in a paginated written book format for a cleaner in-game reading experience. ### ◆ Inventory Browser Browse plugins one at a time through a clean paginated inventory interface. ### ◆ Private Mode Hide plugin information from players and replace it with a custom denial message. ### ◆ Startup Error Lookup Check the last startup error for any disabled plugin directly in-game. ## ▌ Commands --- | Command | Description | |---|---| | /pluginlist | Shows the saved plugin list layout. | | /pluginlist config | Opens the interactive config panel. | | /pluginlist gui | Opens the GUI setup menu. | | /pluginlist browse | Opens the paginated inventory browser. | | /pluginlist book | Opens the written book view. | | /pluginlist error [plugin] | Shows the last startup error for that plugin. | ## ▌ Installation --- 1. Place the .jar file into your server’s plugins folder. 2. Restart your server. 3. Run /pluginlist and choose the style you want to use. ---

PluginListPlus gives your plugin list a cleaner layout, better readability, and a style that actually fits your server.
